title: INDIANA JONES AND THE FATE OF ATLANTIS
subtitle: LucasArts, 1992 · the interactive demo, on ScummVM 0.6.1's SCUMM engine (v5)
argsHint: -p<dir> where the game is, then its name. Other switches of 0.6.1: -g<scaler> (normal, 2x, 3x, 2xsai, super2xsai, supereagle, advmame2x, advmame3x, hq2x, hq3x, tv2x, dotmatrix), -f for full screen, -m<volume> for the music, -s<volume> for the sound effects, -n for no subtitles.
fpsNote: A FALLBACK cap only: the engine paces itself on the SDL clock.

needsData.hint: atlantis-demo/ from atlantis-dos-demo1-en.zip, the demo the ScummVM project distributes

controls: a line of dialogue; a verb, then what it acts on
_why: SCUMM v5 on the same build: dialogue choices, verbs and an inventory. Held to a native g++ build frame by frame with a scripted player (gate-scummvm).
